title: Your profile
intro: Your profile belongs to you across the workspaces you open on this installation. It is stored locally and protected by this computer's account.
identityHelp: This ID identifies your local signing key in shared projects, lab books and workspace exchanges. Changing your profile does not change it. Recover your identity backup on another installation to keep the same ID.
contactHelp: Give this signed public contact file to someone who wants to share work with you. It contains your public signing and encryption keys. Your profile details are not included.
name: Display name
identifiersHelp: Add any identifiers relevant to your work: ORCID, GitHub, an institutional profile, a website, DOI, PubMed ID or your own scheme. Labels and values are yours to define; Observanda does not verify them or use them as passwords.
label: Label
invalid: Check your email, identifier labels and values, and links. Links must use HTTP or HTTPS without embedded credentials.
unavailable: The local identity service is unavailable. Your existing profile has not been changed.
recoveryHelp: Back up your sharing identity to keep your user ID when moving to another computer. Identity recovery restores sharing keys; profile details are stored separately on each installation. Workspace access is managed separately in Storage & access.
